notes.title: "Espionage" Demo Update Now Live!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Espionage Demo Update Now Live![/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44846677/e7c1edaf30cfa2430e79cd79b4c3af411a56dff1.png"][/img][/h1][h3]Dear Agents,[/h3][p]We're excited to announce a major update to the [b]free playable demo[/b] of [i]Espionage[/i] on Steam. This update incorporates valuable feedback from our community, delivering significant improvements and expansions to enhance your gameplay experience.[/p][h3][b]Key Updates:[/b][/h3][p][b]Story & Narrative Overhaul:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Completely revamped plot progression, character dialogues, and cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]Improved presentation of key story elements for clearer narrative flow and character motivations[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced environmental storytelling for deeper immersion[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay Optimizations & Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Performance Boost:[/b] Improved frame rates and stability[/p][/*][*][p][b]Refined Controls:[/b] Smoother movement, stealth mechanics, and interaction responsiveness[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI/UX Improvements:[/b] More intuitive interface and streamlined interactions[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Addressed multiple issues affecting gameplay[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Your Feedback Matters![/b]
Try the updated demo and share your thoughts with us! Your input will help us further polish the game.[/p][p][b]Wishlist Now![/b] If you enjoy the demo, don't forget to add [i]Espionage[/i] to your [b]Steam wishlist[/b]!
[b]Submit Feedback:[/b] Share your suggestions via [b]\[Xiaohongshu][/b] or [b]\[Bilibili][/b] (Search "Espionage").[/p][p]Thank you for supporting [i]Espionage[/i]! Ready to step into the shadows?[/p][p]— The [i]Espionage[/i] Development Team[/p]

notes.title: Get Ready for Espionage at Steam's Eastern Game Fest Sale 2025!
notes.content:
Good evening, everyone!
The side-scrolling story-driven puzzle game [Espionage] will be participating in the Eastern Game Fest Sale 2025 from 10:00 AM (PT), April 23 to 10:00 AM (PT), May 2, 2025!
During the event, players can try out the limited-time demo of Espionage and are warmly encouraged to leave feedback. If you enjoy the game, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist!
Meanwhile, the development team is actively working on improvements based on your suggestions—stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44846677/528829c2ea36dd949e93ae2d0b82d438651159ff.jpg[/img]

Set in an alternate history during World War II, you’ll play as an undercover agent sent deep behind enemy lines. As you carry out a series of revolutionary missions, you’ll face life-or-death decisions and grapple with questions of morality and duty, transforming amidst the flames of war into a true revolutionary.
If you like our story and art style, feel free to join the official Discord: https://discord.gg/gMq9g3ny6B

notes.title: Get Ready for Espionage at Steam's Lunar New Year Sale!
notes.content:
Hello gamers! Espionage will soon be participating in Steam's Lunar New Year Sale! Come join the event and get an awesome gaming experience. During the event, you can experience the trial version in steam! If you like the game, please add it to your wishlist!

Event Period: From 10:00, Jan. 26, 2025 to 10:00, Feb. 9, 2025 (PT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44846677/ba014274ace38f022737fed63f179ef9836eb91e.png[/img]

Espionage is a RPG game with outstanding art style. The story takes place in the parallel world of WW II where you will play as an agent to accomplish revolutionary missions. You shall experience dilemma between life and death, morality and mission. Can you become a real revolutionary soldier after all that hardship?

notes.title: Espionage
notes.content:
Hey folks, the wait is over!

After several months of working overtime, we've finally completed the initial levels of the game. Although there may still be many imperfections, we can't wait to show everyone our progress! Though for now we only have Chinese demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44846677/57cb011e485a3ad87e729d4f585b4a21cc1a1dac.png[/img]

[url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1DM4m1Z7nB/]Click here to watch the Chinese gameplay demo![/url]

For those interested, you can click the link to watch the gameplay demo. Feel free to join our official Discord: https://discord.gg/Rd5CskvRJJ , and share your thoughts with us!
